He submits that the petitioners have made a representation to the Collector Narsinghpur for permitting them to cut the crop, but that has not been decided so far.
2. Considering the aforesaid, this petition is disposed of directing the Collector Narsinghpur to decide the representation of the petitioners and if the crop belongs to them and standing over their land which is acquired by the State, they may be permitted to cut the crop because ultimately that belongs to the owner of the land.
3.
With the aforesaid observation, this petition is disposed of.
